# Astronomical 0.2.70
## Fixed
- Pinned the IPC frame item type for tokio-util 0.7.20 (#1192), preventing frame handling issues when the dependency resolves to 0.7.20. - Attributed the retained live prompt prefix to the context owner in the finalized split (#1236), so prompt-cache accounting and eviction decisions reflect the true owner.
## Internal engineering
- Migrated CI automation from shell scripts into the Rust `xtask` workspace crate. - Consolidated the acceptance tier under `tests/acceptance` and moved unit tests beside their source across all crates. - Retired the legacy test-classification vocabulary from CI, scripts, and documentation. - Added a credential-resolving signed-release front door for release preparation.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 or later, Apple silicon (arm64). - No configuration schema changes; existing state and settings are preserved on upgrade.
This release is distributed as a signed and notarized DMG. The update arrives through the public GitHub release and the signed Sparkle update feed.
